## Codex execution contract

**CGS-17 QA evidence contract:** Treat task APIs and hooks as optional and disclose when unavailable. A native delegate must actually run to be independent; otherwise use an explicitly labelled in-session fallback. Prior user authorization and host permissions govern all writes. Use the actual engine and test framework and verify its documented failure assertion API before generating helpers. FAIL_IF is a placeholder, never a shippable API. Keep seeded, isolated, deterministic helpers and do not present an unrun helper as verified.
